title: Release v1.39.2 (indexer quota fix) — NOT A CHAIN UPGRADE, DO NOT SUBMIT
summary: THIS PROPOSAL MUST NOT BE SUBMITTED. v1.39.2 is an ordinary release: it registers no SetUpgradeHandler, so submitting it would halt the chain at the plan height with nothing able to resume it. The file names the current release only so scripts/test_upgrade.sh can detect that this release ships no chain change and run in --no-chain-upgrade mode; the rehearsal never submits it in that mode. v1.39.2 fixes an indexer that treated a subscriber tier dropping mid-epoch as corrupted chain data and stopped, which stalled every node's indexer on the same block. Nodes install it with mirage-update. Replace this file with a real plan, and register the matching handler, only when a release actually changes consensus.
